actionAdapters.entry: confirmed Content scene ownership, existing Collector/Package, default Package mapping, location, source call site and handle owner
actionAdapters.when: 只读冻结资源化场景的解析前提；不改 Collector、Config、Scene 或 Build Settings

actionAdapters.entry: confirmed business Content-scene owner, existing call site and local Play probe
actionAdapters.when: 只修改冻结的业务加载/卸载源码与局部探针，持有 ISceneHandle 并在精确结束时机仅调用一次 UnloadAsync
目标已确认是当前默认 Package 可解析的 Nova 资源化场景，且 mode、owner、取消语义与卸载时机已经冻结

actionAdapters.entry: Unity script refresh, compilation and Play Mode content-scene load/unload inspection
actionAdapters.when: 仅观察冻结调用点的编译与运行证据；不编辑序列化 Scene、Prefab、Collector 或 Config

allow: confirmed existing business call site for the Content scene
confirmed local C# Play probe for the frozen load and unload lifecycle
deny: BundleCollectorSetting, ConfigMasterSO, ConfigRuntimeSO or Package/default-Package mapping
entry Scene, Build Settings, Nova.prefab or serialized Unity YAML
normal non-scene resource or Prefab loading lifecycle
direct YooAsset scene API, Object.Destroy, SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync, ordinary Release() or a discarded ISceneHandle
Bundle or Player output, cache cleanup, device installation, CDN publication or unrelated business code

requiredFor: ambiguous scene ownership, Package/default-Package mapping, location, mode, load owner, call site, unload timing, cancellation behavior, runtime coordinate, Play probe or allowed write set
create or change a business Content-scene owner, call site, transition behavior or public contract
change Collector, Package/default-Package mapping, Config, entry Scene, Build Settings, Nova Prefab or serialized Unity asset
delete or move a scene, build Bundle or Player, install to device, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认目标 Content 场景、资源化 Package/default-Package 映射、唯一 location、LoadSceneMode、唯一 Handle 所有者、卸载触发与时机、取消语义、运行坐标、Play 探针和最小写入集；任一输入或范围变化后旧确认失效。

evidence: Content 场景归属、现有 Collector/Package、默认 Package 映射与唯一 location 的冻结证据
LoadSceneMode、加载调用点、唯一 ISceneHandle 所有者、取消语义和卸载时机的冻结记录
业务源码只使用 Nova.Asset.LoadSceneAsync，并在 Handle 返回后由同一所有者恰好一次 UnloadAsync 的证据
Unity 编译无本次新增错误
当前项目实际运行坐标下的 Play Mode load、持有和 unload 完成证据，以及卸载后不再访问 Handle 的证据
